termsSubtitle: Electronic Locker System — Kazan International Airport
termsUpdated: Last updated: May 2026 — Electronic Locker System v1.0
terms1Content: The Electronic Locker System provides temporary luggage storage services at Kazan International Airport. Users may reserve lockers of three sizes: Small (₽100), Medium (₽150), and Large (₽200).
terms2Content: Reservations are confirmed only after successful payment. A 4-digit PIN will be sent to your registered email address upon payment confirmation. Keep this PIN safe — it is required to release your locker.
terms3Content: Your name and email address are collected exclusively for the purpose of sending your locker PIN and managing your reservation. We do not share your personal data with third parties.
terms4Content: The Electronic Locker System is not responsible for the loss, theft, or damage of items stored in the lockers. Users store items at their own risk. Do not store valuables, perishables, or prohibited items.
terms5Content: Lockers must be released using the PIN provided at the time of reservation. In case of PIN loss, contact airport staff for assistance. The system administrator reserves the right to force-release any locker.
terms6Content: It is strictly prohibited to store weapons, explosives, flammable materials, illegal substances, perishable food, or any items prohibited by airport security regulations.
terms7Content: Payments are non-refundable once the locker has been reserved and the PIN has been issued. In case of system failure, please contact airport staff.
terms8Content: By proceeding with payment, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms & Conditions.
